operational-example.copy: Use Phone Input to capture one localized phone number with visible country selector, calling code, formatting, validation, and recovery copy.

scenario.title: Driver invite phone
scenario.meta: Country code, number, and OTP handoff
rationale: Phone Input keeps the number, prefix, helper, and validation together as one field.
It can prepare an OTP handoff without sending or sequencing verification.
Use a pattern when phone capture includes country search, OTP delivery, retries, or identity recovery.

items.rule: Names the phone field and why it is needed.
Shows the active flag, country name, and dialing code while keeping large country search in patterns.
Captures the local number with readable grouping.
Reinforces validity or handoff state with text-backed meaning.
Explains OTP, support, or recovery consequences.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, error, warning, valid, focus, hover, default
items: Associate the label and helper text with the input.
Expose the country selector and calling code so the flag is not the only country signal.
Do not send OTP automatically from the field.

variants.copy: Phone Input variants define field density and handoff treatment while verification system remains a pattern.

states.copy: Phone Input states communicate focus, validity, warning, error, and disabled behavior without triggering verification on their own.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant defines field treatment; state defines validation and availability while OTP sequencing stays in patterns.

full-width.copy: Phone Input can fill forms, drawers, and mobile auth panels while the prefix and number keep readable rhythm.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Keep the country code visible on small viewports and move country search or OTP resend behavior into patterns.

viewport-organization.copy: Phone Input stays a field component; viewport rules decide target size, prefix visibility, and handoff placement.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use large field height and keep prefix visible.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep helper copy with the field.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use compact treatment only when prefix remains readable.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify label, prefix, value, variant, and validation state before composing invite or OTP flows.

api-foundations.copy: Phone Input API exposes label, value, country, countries, prefix, variant, state, helper copy, and value metadata while reusing Input control rhythm, focus, and accessibility.

props.name: prefix
props.notes: Legacy dialing prefix fallback when country is not provided.

props.name: country
props.notes: ISO country code used by the compact selector and flag primitive.

props.name: countries
props.type: Array<{ country: string, label: string, callingCode: string, nationalLength: number }>
props.notes: Allowed country options for the selector.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Controls the local phone capture treatment without owning OTP delivery or recovery flow.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps to the shared Input control density.

props.name: error
props.notes: Error helper text; sets aria-invalid and error state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called with national digits and country/calling-code metadata.

rejectIf: The field has no visible label.
Country and calling code are not perceivable.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Phone Input as one localized number field. Agents may place it when the product needs a phone value, but humans confirm country rules, OTP handoff, recovery impact, and pattern context.
canDecide: Use Phone Input for driver invites, support contact, or OTP preparation.
Use valid only when formatting and reachability rules pass.
Use compact only when prefix and helper remain readable.
mustAsk: The field triggers SMS or identity verification.
Country selection or phone formatting rules are unclear.
Phone capture affects account recovery or financial decisions.
rejectIf: Phone Input owns the OTP journey.
The country signal is flag-only or visual-only.
miel.handoff: I am using Phone Input for one localized number. Please confirm country rules, formatting, OTP or recovery use, validation copy, and surrounding pattern behavior.
